reasons: The ordinary question test may call a live AI service depending on settings.
Coverage is limited to five cases.
No test covers the summary AI call or its mock fallback.

terms.meaning: a Python tool that runs automated tests and reports failures
a statement in a test that must be true for the test to pass
a test that waits for slow operations, such as network calls, to finish

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports for the test file
sections.what: Brings in the test runner, the async test marker, and the summarizer and chatbot classes being tested.
sections.why: Needed to call the code under test.
sections.watch_out: Async tests need an async test plugin, which is not listed in the requirements file.

sections.name: test_plausibility_safety_net_flags_impossible_hemoglobin
sections.title: Impossible hemoglobin test
sections.what: Feeds in a hemoglobin of 142 with a critical flag, then checks that the finding becomes needs verification with the OCR note and that the matching risk flag is softened.
sections.why: Likely reason: guards against the most dangerous false alarm, a fake critical result caused by a dropped decimal point.
sections.watch_out: If the wording of the note or recommendation changes in the code, the text checks here must change too.

sections.name: test_plausibility_safety_net_flags_leading_zero_creatinine
sections.title: Creatinine leading zero test
sections.what: Feeds in a creatinine value of 09 and checks that it is marked needs verification with the OCR note.
sections.why: Likely reason: covers the leading-zero rule, which is a separate path in the code.
sections.watch_out: Only this two-character form is tested, so other dropped-decimal forms have no coverage.

sections.name: test_plausibility_safety_net_preserves_physiologically_valid_findings
sections.title: Valid values stay unchanged test
sections.what: Checks that normal glucose and hemoglobin values keep their normal status, so the safety check does not flag everything.
sections.why: Likely reason: a check that flags every value would make the summaries useless.
sections.watch_out: The test checks only the status fields, so changes to the notes would not be caught.

sections.name: test_chatbot_emergency_keyword_intercept
sections.title: Emergency intercept test
sections.what: Sends a message describing chest pain and inability to breathe, then checks for the emergency flag, the 112 number, the emergency room wording, and the call suggestion.
sections.why: Likely reason: confirms the highest-priority safety path returns before any AI call.
sections.watch_out: The test checks exact wording, so rewording the emergency message breaks it even when behavior is correct.

sections.name: test_chatbot_non_emergency_query_passthrough
sections.title: Ordinary question passthrough test
sections.what: Sends a normal glucose question and checks that no emergency flag appears.
sections.why: Likely reason: confirms the emergency check does not block everyday questions.
sections.watch_out: If an AI key is set in the environment, this test sends a real request, so its result depends on settings and the network.

summary: Automated checks for the AI service's two most sensitive behaviors: the impossible-value safety check and the emergency phrase intercept.
purpose: Confirms that impossible lab values get flagged, normal values are left alone, emergency phrases trigger the emergency reply, and ordinary questions do not.
why: Likely reason: these safety rules matter for patients, so tests guard them against accidental change.
how: First it imports the summarizer and chatbot. Then it runs three synchronous checks of the value safety net: an impossible hemoglobin, a leading-zero creatinine, and normal values. Then it runs two asynchronous checks of the chatbot: an emergency message and an ordinary glucose question.
inputs: Hand-written example data inside each test.
outputs: Pass or fail results from pytest.
risks: The ordinary question test does not block network calls, so if an AI key is set it calls the real provider. Only five cases are covered.
debug: Run pytest from the AI service folder. If an error mentions async handling, check that an async test plugin is installed. If the ordinary question test fails with a network error, check the key settings.
